stories.title: Mohamad meets BN, PN reps to resolve MB-related issues
stories.summary: Barisan Nasional deputy chairman Mohamad Hasan also says any matter concerning the state administration must be carried out in accordance with its constitution and rule of law.

stories.title: Bersatu leader attends Amanah Youth convention
stories.summary: This follows Amanah's call for Pakatan Harapan to adopt a 'big tent' approach to recapture Malay support, following a string of electoral losses.

stories.title: YTL Power denies Johor data centre facilitated Nvidia chip transfers to China
stories.summary: Company says its services comply with Malaysian laws and US trade controls.

stories.title: Contractor wins RM1.93mil dispute over Lembaga Getah Malaysia’s 2017 project
stories.summary: Court orders KLIA Associates Sdn Bhd and KLIA Consultancy Services Sdn Bhd to pay Koridor Padu Sdn Bhd its outstanding retention sums.

stories.title: DAP MP draws flak from allies, foes over Terengganu prayer policy remarks
stories.summary: Leaders including from PKR, DAP, Amanah, and PAS demand retraction, apology.

stories.title: No intention to offend religious sensitivities, says Khoo
stories.summary: The Melaka DAP chief says he respects Friday prayers and was merely questioning a policy that also affects non-Muslim businesses.

stories.title: 18-year delay shouldn’t sink convent land claim, court told
stories.summary: Counsel for two missionary groups argues that the law governing land titles in Melaka and Penang sets no time limit for obtaining replacement titles.

stories.title: Zi Yu-Noraqilah continue fairy-tale run at Hong Kong Open
stories.summary: The young Malaysian combination reach their first World Tour Super 500 semi-finals after defeating a higher-ranked US pair.

stories.title: Sabah PH hopes RM900mil interim payment made by Dec 4
stories.summary: Sabah PH chairman Mustapha Sakmud says this will allow the allocation to be included in the state government's revenue and spent on the people next year.

stories.title: Two more Air Force personnel held in drug trafficking probe, total seven
stories.summary: 13 suspects detained, including six civilians, in nationwide operations.

stories.title: Adam raps Khoo over criticism of Terengganu Friday prayer directive
stories.summary: The Melaka PKR acting chief urges his DAP counterpart to respect Terengganu's state laws.

stories.title: Myanmar calls ICJ genocide ruling over Rohingya 'unfair'
stories.summary: Decision made by international court was not unanimous, spokesperson says.

stories.title: YTL Power denies data centres transferred Nvidia chips to China
stories.summary: Company says its data centres in Johor serve multiple global customers, including hyperscalers from the US, under arrangements that are compliant with domestic laws and US trade controls.

stories.title: Man who posed as royal aide gets another 27 months for fraud
stories.summary: Al Zulfadly Alias pleads guilty to cheating two victims of RM73,000 in a vehicle auction scam.

stories.title: 2 Chinese nationals hurt in armed clash over parking in Cheras
stories.summary: Cheras police chief Rosdi Daud says two suspects have been arrested following the 4am brawl in front of a convenience store.

stories.title: Cops seize RM1.27mil in smuggled, unregistered health products

stories.title: Gov’t steps up food security preparations for El Niño

stories.title: Annuar Rapaee likely to defend Nangka in Sarawak polls
stories.summary: Abang Johari Openg says Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu is seeking to strengthen its leadership while grooming potential successors.

stories.title: Youth groups call for Najib's house arrest to be suspended, announce third anti-graft rally
stories.summary: They also accuse PM of trying to steer clear of the matter.

stories.title: Tiger that killed Orang Asli man shot dead near Sungai Siput
stories.summary: Perhilitan says its men had to shoot the endangered species in self-defence.

stories.title: US Treasury presses Singapore, Malaysia on Iran sanctions compliance
stories.summary: The US is urging additional scrutiny of 'high-risk' sectors such as maritime transport, aviation services and procurement networks to ensure they are not fronting for Iran.

stories.title: Alphabet raises US$4.19bil in Canadian bond offering
stories.summary: The Google parent said the money raised would be used for general corporate purposes, which could include repayment of outstanding debt.

stories.title: DNeX rides high as tech stocks wallow in a sea of red
stories.summary: Tech company’s shares jump 13% after its Q3 net profit surged 255% to RM42.63 million.

stories.title: Wall Street futures slip as Anthropic debut fails to reassure AI investors
stories.summary: Anthropic shares slid 6.8% in premarket trading after surging more than 17% on Thursday in their highly anticipated market debut.

stories.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs on slow turnaround, fuel costs
stories.summary: The airline lost an average of €20 million a month in the first nine months, with high fuel costs and strike action adding to the pressure.

stories.title: Ringgit flat against greenback, higher against other currencies
stories.summary: The ringgit traded within a tight range against the US dollar, with technical indicators pointing to oversold conditions and limited downside risk in the near-term, says an analyst.

stories.title: UK’s retail sales beat forecasts after govt tells households to stock up
stories.summary: Britain's government advised households to keep three days of emergency supplies at home, citing online security flaws and a record-setting summer of heat, drought and wildfires.

stories.title: Bursa ends week lower on continued heavyweight selling
stories.summary: Selling pressure persisted in selected heavyweight stocks, particularly data centre-related counters.

stories.title: TSMC tightens China AI chip curbs as new US rules close manufacturing loophole
stories.summary: Chinese chip designers will generally be limited to older 28-nanometre and 40-nanometre processes unless customers obtain US export licences for advanced manufacturing orders.

stories.title: TikTok launches tool to help public figures detect deepfakes globally
stories.summary: The tool is being gradually rolled out, allowing politicians and popular TikTok accounts to report AI-generated content using their likeness without consent.

stories.title: US lawmakers urge curbs on China’s aerospace sector
stories.summary: A congressional report warns that Western aerospace ties have boosted China’s military aviation, scrutinising Airbus deals and urging the FAA not to certify Chinese aircraft for US flights.

stories.title: Honda debuts hybrid SUV for Asia in pivot from failed EV bet
stories.summary: The Avancier will not be sold in the US, Honda’s biggest market, but will occupy the top spot in its Asia-Pacific SUV lineup, above the popular CR-V.
